app.name: Wisp
app.tagline: A light launcher for your Epic library

boot.failedHint: Check that your user folders are accessible and try again.

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: The games you own on Epic, in one place.
library.checkingAccountBody: Asking Legendary who is signed in.
library.loadingBody: This takes a moment the first time, while Epic sends the full list.
library.emptyBody: Nothing came back from Epic. If that looks wrong, try refreshing.
library.noMatchesBody: No game matches the search for {{query}}.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.subtitle: One download at a time, the rest queued.
downloads.emptyBody: Installing and updating games arrives in sprint 3.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Wisp keeps everything local. Nothing is sent anywhere.
settings.languageHint: Choose a language or follow your system.

runtime.setupTitle: One setup step and you are done
runtime.setupIntro: Wisp talks to Epic through Legendary, the open source Epic Games client. It needs to download it once (about {{size}}) from Legendary's official GitHub releases.
runtime.setupDetails: No Python, no administrator rights, nothing added to your PATH. Everything lands in Wisp's own folder and goes away when you uninstall Wisp.
runtime.checksumVerified: Matches the SHA-256 published by GitHub
runtime.checksumUnverified: No checksum published for this build
runtime.updateHint: Wisp never updates Legendary on its own.
runtime.repairHint: Repairing downloads Legendary again from scratch.
runtime.brokenBody: Wisp could not run the Legendary binary. Repairing the runtime usually fixes this.

auth.title: Sign in with Epic
auth.body: Wisp opens the real Epic login page in a separate window. Your password goes to Epic and never passes through Wisp.
auth.privacy: Wisp keeps the session Legendary gets back in its own folder, and nothing else.
auth.manualStep1: Open the Epic login page in your browser.
auth.manualStep2: Sign in. The page then shows a short block of text.
auth.manualStep3: Copy the value of authorizationCode and paste it here.
auth.signOutHint: Signing out also clears the cached library and cover art.

game.notFoundBody: This game is not in the cached library. Refreshing may bring it back.
game.thirdParty: This title is managed by {{store}}, so Wisp cannot install or launch it.
game.noBuild: Epic offers no build of this title for your platform, so Wisp cannot install it.
game.actionsSoon: Installing, updating and launching arrive in sprints 3 and 4.
game.noDlc: This game has no DLC in your account.
